breakpoint.conditionLabel: Condition expression (optional; pauses only when truthy)
breakpoint.conditionHint: Breakpoints are valid for this session only and are not saved with the Graph; a broken expression fails safe and is treated as not matching.
breakpoint.hitCountLabel: Hit count hitCount (pause once every N hits; leave empty to pause on every hit)
breakpoint.logMessageLabel: Log breakpoint logMessage (non-empty = only log on hit, do not pause)
breakpoint.logMessagePlaceholder: e.g. reached the refund node (the message is output as-is, no interpolation)
breakpoint.logMessageHint: When a message is provided this breakpoint becomes a log breakpoint: on hit it only prints to the debug console and does not pause the run; v1 does not combine it with hitCount and the message is emitted as-is without interpolation.
breakpoint.exceptionLabel: Exception breakpoint (pauses when the node raises, docs/28 §3.2)
breakpoint.exceptionHint: When enabled, an exception raised by the node logic pauses first and shows the exception type and message; it is re-raised as-is after step/continue (v1 cannot ignore and continue), and stop ends debugging; with no condition expression, continue mode pauses only when this node raises and does not pause on normal passage.
